turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
We ship to several European countries: France, Corsica, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, as well as the Vatican and San Marino.

For Switzerland, customs duties and Swiss VAT (8.1%) are already included in the selling price displayed on our site.

For other areas outside the European Union, taxes and customs fees may be requested by the carrier upon delivery.🙂

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
Standard delivery typically takes 48 hours within Metropolitan France for most products. However, this timeline does not apply to orders that include bed bases (sommiers) or sofas.

For deliveries to other European countries, the lead time is approximately 72 hours.

Small items, such as pillows or bed linen, are generally shipped within 24 to 72 hours.🙂

turns.q: Are any items final sale or non-returnable?
turns.replyTail:
We cannot accept returns for products that have been damaged or significantly stained after delivery.
Promotional gifts: If your order included a free gift, it must be returned along with the main item for the refund to be fully approved. Returning a free gift on its own does not trigger any refund.

All other items, including bed linen and protectors, can be returned within their specific trial period (30 days for these accessories) as long as they are in a condition suitable for normal use. 🙂
turns.replyText:
Most of our products are eligible for our trial periods, but there are a few important exceptions to keep in mind:

Repeat purchases: If you have already returned a product in a specific category (for example, a mattress), you will not be eligible for a second free trial on a subsequent purchase of a product in that same category. In this case, the second purchase is considered final.
Unopened mattresses: For hygiene and product quality reasons, mattresses must be opened within 30 days of delivery. If a mattress remains compressed in its packaging for more than 30 days, it can no longer be returned.
Damaged items: We cannot accept returns for products that have been damaged or significantly stained after delivery.
Promotional gifts: If your order included a free gift, it must be returned along with the main item for the refund to be fully approved. Returning a free gift on its own does not trigger any refund.

All other items, including bed linen and protectors, can be returned within their specific trial period (30 days for these accessories) as long as they are in a condition suitable for normal use. 🙂

turns.replyText:
At Tediber, we take pride in the quality of our products, and they come with comprehensive warranties to protect you against manufacturing defects:

Mattresses: Our Hybrid mattresses are covered by a 10-year warranty. The Grand Tedi (children's) and Baby Tedi mattresses are covered for 5 years.
Beds and Bed Bases: Items like our upholstered bed bases, slatted bases, and wooden bed frames come with a 5-year warranty.
Bedding Accessories: Our duvets, pillows, bolsters, and wool mattress toppers are also protected by a 5-year warranty.
Sofas and Sofa Beds: These items are covered by a 2-year warranty.

This warranty typically covers significant manufacturing defects, such as visible sagging of the foam (greater than 2.5 cm for mattresses), physical cracking, or faults in the cover fabrication (like broken zippers or unraveled seams).

If you notice a defect, simply send a description of the issue along with photos or videos to hello@tediber.com. Our team will then inspect the situation and arrange for a repair or replacement if the defect is covered. 🙂
